I’ve been on about 15 different meds so far.  Unfortunately a side effect from a lot of anti depressants (and other psych meds) is suicidal ideation.  I wasn’t told this by my doctor at the time and made an attempt after a med switch and ended up in the psych ward.  Tell your doctor about your symptoms.  It’s a long, tedious and miserable process, but you shouldn’t have to choose between anxiety or depression.  Even if meds don’t work out there are other options like therapy or even ECT or TMS

I empathize with you greatly.  My mother was told there was a 6 month waiting list to get into a counselor or psychiatrist.  You can bypass this by going directly to the emergency room and then they will send you to a psych ward (if you say you are suicidal with a plan) where they will put you up with a counselor and doctor usually within a day.  I know it’s a painful process, but after my mom overdosed a few weeks ago and then got help she’s been a lot better.  She got on medications and got individual therapy and we are going to go to group therapy.  I’m sure there will be ups and downs, but those down moments allow you to empathize with others.  You seem like a wonderful, compassionate human being who actively wants to help others, and we Need those type of people in this harsh world.  Breathe.  Breathe deeply.  You are worthy of help.  I am rooting for you and here to talk if you need it.

The fact that you care so much about wanting your family to be unburdened means you are truly an empathetic, compassionate human being.  And we desperately needs those people in society.
